C2_surface_anchor.statement: free-surface |dr|/h/alpha vs the continuum 3-D value within 15 % at h/dx = 1.3

C3_pre_fix.statement: the pre-fix 2-D normalisation under-corrects a 3-D cloud by more than 20x at dx = 0.02 (sigma_2/sigma_3 = 10h/7)

C4_wall_branch.statement: 3-D wall residual < 1e-10 for wall_factor = 2 and > 0.4 for wall_factor = 1

C5_flow_invariants.statement: every flow run: mass drift == 0 and |energy drift| < 1 %

C6_regularisation.statement: at dx = 0.02 the TVC run's close-pair fraction (r < 0.7 dx) is at least 50 % below the baseline's

C7_non_intrusive.statement: with the corrected frame, TVC's front MAE against Ritter does not exceed the baseline MAE by more than 20 % (relative)
C7_non_intrusive.kind: grading; the absolute 15 % gate lives on the 2-D leg (3-D front lag vs a 2-D shallow-water reference is physical)
